table_title: List the 20 largest islands in the world by area, including their rank, area in square kilometers, and ocean or region.
db_analog: SELECT rank, island, area_sq_km, region FROM britannica_world_largest_islands ORDER BY area_sq_km DESC LIMIT 20
temporal_note: Britannica page accessed on 2026-04-24. Island areas are stable geographic facts, but published area values can differ slightly across references; this staged instance uses Britannica's stated ranking and square-kilometer values.
_extraction_notes: Built from Britannica's 'world's largest islands' article. The article gives the 10 largest islands followed by the next 15 largest islands; this staged instance takes ranks 1 through 20, preserves Britannica's ordering, stores the square-kilometer area as a bare numeric value, and normalizes the parenthetical location text into a Region column. operation_type is projection as the closest UI-supported coarse operation; the top-k semantics are represented by query_category=top_k and the ORDER BY/LIMIT db_analog. No supplemental rows or sources were used.
